title: Login, session and logout
verify: open the auth modal and submit KASP_VERIFY_USER / KASP_VERIFY_PASSWORD
GET /api/v1/auth/me returns the same username and role
logout clears the session and /api/v1/auth/me returns 401
expected: Login sets the kasp_session HttpOnly cookie and returns csrf_token; authenticated pages render the user menu.
gotchas: The admin account may carry must_change_password=1; use a dedicated test account. Never print passwords or tokens into evidence.

title: Compressor design calculation
verify: load a preset or enter P_in, T_in, P_out, flow and gas composition
assert KPI cards and the 7 result sub-tabs render
expected: Design results appear without console errors; shaft power, pressure ratio and stage table are populated.
gotchas: Protected API calls need the session cookie plus X-CSRF-Token; calculate through the UI rather than only the API when verifying rendering.

title: ASME PTC-10 performance test
verify: assert derived efficiency, tolerances and verdict render
expected: PTC-10 comparison table and verdict are populated; no NaN or Infinity is rendered.
gotchas: Empty or zero measured values must show a validation message, not a traceback.

title: EOS x method engineering shootout
verify: assert the SSE ranking table fills
expected: All available EOS/method pairs are ranked and the best row is highlighted.
gotchas: The matrix is CPU-heavy; the job endpoint is asynchronous and may need polling or SSE.

title: Station summary and equipment cards
verify: assert summary cards show flow, pressure ratio, cooler duty and unit count
expected: Summary values match the latest design calculation and the selected unit count.
gotchas: design_num_units from the last design drives the layout; changing only flow may not change unit count.

title: 2D P&ID and pipe schedule
entrypoint: 3D İstasyon & P&ID tab > P&ID / Boru Tablosu
verify: assert the SVG P&ID contains suction, discharge, anti-surge, cooler and bypass lines
assert NPS labels are dynamic, not hardcoded
assert the 15-line pipe table is populated
expected: P&ID topology follows the process flow diagram and every line shows its NPS/OD.
gotchas: Suction and discharge headers must have equal nominal size after sizing.

title: 3D digital twin loads
verify: assert the canvas is non-empty and no console error is raised
expected: Procedural station renders with pipes, headers, separators, filters, coolers, buildings and turbines.
gotchas: Only the expected guest 401 /api/v1/auth/me is acceptable when logged out. WebGL may be unavailable in headless CI; record blocked instead of fail.

title: Equipment click, HUD and camera fly-to
entrypoint: 3D scene > click a vessel, cooler, building or valve skid
verify: assert #equip-telemetry-hud is visible with process values
assert the selection highlight box is visible
expected: The HUD shows equipment-specific values, the selection outline appears and the camera flies to the equipment.
gotchas: inspect() is a debug bridge; a real pointer click must also pass the 6 px drag threshold.

title: Equipment teardown popup
entrypoint: Click air cooler, cyclone or cartridge filter; or HUD > Teardown Aç
verify: assert the parts list has at least 6 entries
move the explode slider and assert part positions change
press Escape and assert the overlay is removed
expected: An exploded 3D view opens with process data, a clickable part list, labels, explode/assemble and reset controls.
gotchas: Teardown keys are air_coolers, cyclones and cartridge_filters only. Cleanup must dispose renderer, controls and geometries.

title: PDF design report
verify: assert a PDF download is produced and non-empty
expected: A multi-section PDF with design, station and equipment results downloads.
gotchas: Turkish characters require a Unicode-capable PDF font; check for tofu boxes.

title: Module and station Excel export
verify: assert the workbook contains design, module and station sheets
expected: Excel workbook opens and sheet names/values match the on-screen results.
gotchas: Do not regress the i18n sheet titles used by downstream engineers.

title: Project save, load, import and export
verify: create a project from the current design
reload the page and reopen it
expected: Inputs, gas composition and results persist across reload, export and import.
gotchas: .kasp JSON must stay backward compatible; never store secrets in project files.

title: System logs and live stream
verify: assert the SSE stream appends new rows
clear logs and assert the table empties
expected: Log rows show timestamp, level, logger and message; the live stream reconnects after a drop.
gotchas: Never render raw HTML from log messages; escape user-controlled text.

title: User administration
verify: list users, create a test user, reset its password, delete it
assert a non-admin session gets 403 on GET /api/v1/users
expected: Admin CRUD works and every mutation enforces role checks and CSRF.
gotchas: Use throwaway usernames and delete them in the same run; never log generated passwords.

title: Integration modules
verify: assert the module results render and persist with the project
expected: Module schema, calculation and persistence match the Python service contract.
gotchas: Steam-service control valves remain excluded by design; do not add them.

title: OpenCode and Antigravity skill discovery
verify: assert every SKILL.md has valid name/description frontmatter
expected: Both harnesses discover the same skills from .agents/skills with no duplicated copies.
gotchas: Skill name must equal its folder name. Do not use harness-only tool names inside SKILL.md; use shell commands and relative paths.
